core_principles: Trustworthy & Premium: Deep blues and clean whites to establish authority.
Indian Context: Warmth through orange accents and relatable imagery.
Mobile-First: Bottom navigation for ease of use on phones.
Clarity over Clutter: High contrast, readable fonts, and distinct hierarchy.

rules: Use Bold (700) for all major headings.
Use Regular (400) for body text to ensure readability.
Headings should be dark (#1A1A1A) or Primary Blue (#1B3A6B).
Avoid using Inter or default sans-serif fonts.

usage_rules.primary: Use for Sidebar background, Primary Headings, Active States (text), and borders.
usage_rules.secondary: Use strictly for Call-to-Actions (Buttons), Highlights, and important notifications. DO NOT overuse.
usage_rules.background: Main page background should be White (#FFFFFF) or very light Slate (#F8FAFC).
usage_rules.sidebar: Deep Blue (#1B3A6B) background with White text. Active link: White bg/text with Orange accent or transparent with Orange text.

grid_rules: Desktop: Four columns (grid-cols-4) for summary cards.
Summary Cards: Use a 4-column grid where each card takes 1 column on desktop, 2 on tablet, 4 on mobile.

buttons.style: rounded-lg font-medium transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
buttons.cta: bg-[#E8500A] text-white hover:bg-[#d14404] shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transform hover:-translate-y-0.5

cards.style: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

navigation.sidebar: bg-[#1B3A6B] text-white h-screen w-64 hidden md:flex flex-col fixed left-0 top-0
navigation.sidebar_link: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors text-sm font-medium
navigation.bottom_nav: bg-white border-t border-slate-200 fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full md:hidden flex justify-around py-3 z-50 shadow-[0_-4px_6px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]
navigation.bottom_nav_item: flex flex-col items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-500

visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid heavy gradients. Use subtle linear gradients for 'Premium' card backgrounds (e.g., White to Slate-50).
visual_enhancers.rounded: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons/inputs.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise or geometric pattern (opacity 0.03) on the Auth pages background if possible.

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast ratio is at least 4.5:1. Blue text on White is safe. Orange text on White needs to be large or bold.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-[#1B3A6B]).
accessibility.labels: All inputs must have visible labels or aria-labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Auth Layout' separate from 'Dashboard Layout'.
Use 'Outlet' from react-router-dom for nested routing in Dashboard.
For the Sidebar, create a recursive or mapped component using the list: Dashboard, My Guide, Checklists, Budget Tracker, Progress Tracker, My Library, AI Assistant, Settings.
The 'My Guide', 'Checklists', etc. should be protected routes.
Mobile Navigation should ONLY show: Dashboard (Home), Progress (Tracker), Menu (More). Keep it simple, max 4-5 items. Maybe 'Home', 'Guide', 'Budget', 'Menu'.
Use Shadcn components but override the default radius to '0.5rem' or '0.75rem' (rounded-lg/xl) to match the friendly vibe.
The Dashboard Summary Cards should be: Reading Progress, Checklist Progress, Budget Used, Construction Stage.
Remember: NO EMOJIS in UI. Use Lucide React icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Create depth through layered design elements.
Use specific properties for transitions (NOT transition: all).
